tools.name: gate_search_access
tools.description: Search APIs listed in Odile Machine Access. Each is a domain-verified access contract: the calls an AI agent may make, the owner's price for each in credits (1 credit = USD 0.10; 0 is free), rate and daily limits, and a connect URL. Read-only; connecting is an HTTP POST to the connect URL.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "access" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: gate_search_access · Public sink: gate_search_access.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: gate_search_access · Public sink: gate_search_access

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
